_comment: ZenZork v2 Story 6 (#10568) hardware defs -- authored data only, ships empty (Episode content is #10573). Each entry: id, era, role, condition (broken|incomplete|working -- descriptive flavor, not enforced by the engine), requires (list of OTHER hardware ids that must be repaired first -- the dependency chain, e.g. a sound card needs RAM chips found+repaired before it can be repaired itself), grants (free-form object, surfaced in collect/repair results for Episode content to key off), core_value (number, summed into zenzork_state.inference_core_components on repair -- 'integrate into inference core'), guaranteed (bool, default false -- true means fixed_room/fixed_landmark are used directly instead of random placement among eligible_habitats; false means random placement, same mechanism as Story 5's collectibles), eligible_habitats (landmark 'type' values, used when guaranteed=false), fixed_room/fixed_landmark (used when guaranteed=true), item_name, achievement_name, flavor_dungeon, flavor_zork. Separate placement/state from Story 5's collectible_defs.json -- different domain, same mechanism, not reused directly so each can evolve independently. SPOILER CURTAIN (mandatory): achievement_name, flavor_dungeon, flavor_zork must be base64 at rest -- decoded once at load, same convention as book_lore.json. Plain text in these fields will decode to garbage. id/era/role/condition/requires/grants/core_value/guaranteed/eligible_habitats/fixed_room/fixed_landmark/item_name stay plain.
